reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation type — the issue is that discord_guild_check is NOT called). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions table; entry point is an external user's valid Supabase session cookie, which is untrusted. Gate 3: src/app/auth/ and Discord membership verification bypass are explicitly in scope. An attacker can trigger this via a valid Supabase session cookie by directly POSTing to server action endpoints (e.g., attendance recording in actions.ts), causing unauthorized attendance operations after Discord membership revocation, since the guild check at auth/callback/route.ts L106-119 is commented out ('一時的にコメントアウト') and the compensating layout-level check in dashboard/layout.tsx is fully bypassable via direct server action invocation.
